theorem_rows.name: tail_envelope_phase_saving_identity
theorem_rows.statement: For each side, H-2C=(H-2T)+2(T-C), where H is half-grid survivors, T is the full tail-prime envelope, and C is no-slot phase-band load.

theorem_rows.name: tail_envelope_sufficient_gate
theorem_rows.statement: If H>2T, then the no-slot phase-band pressure defect is excluded without using the quadratic phase saving.

theorem_rows.name: phase_saving_rescue_gate
theorem_rows.statement: When H<=2T, the exact target is equivalent to T-C >= T-floor((H-1)/2).

theorem_rows.name: finite_no_exact_pressure_defect
theorem_rows.statement: The finite audit finds no exact phase-band pressure defect up to the tested bound.

theorem_rows.name: global_tail_or_saving_bound
theorem_rows.statement: A global proof still needs either H>2T, or enough quadratic phase saving T-C, for every prime-square side.

plain_conclusion: 本步没有转换目标，而是把当前精确余量拆成 `H-2C=(H-2T)+2(T-C)`。`H` 是半网格幸存数，也就是平方锚侧短区间素数数；`T` 是全部尾素包络；`C` 是上一层 no-slot 二次相位带尾素数。若 `H>2T`，不需要相位信息即可闭合；若 `H<=2T`，则必须由二次相位节省 `T-C` 补足，且所需节省精确为 `max(0, T-floor((H-1)/2))`。有限扫描中尾包络失败点存在，但全部由相位节省补足；全局仍需证明尾包络正余量或二次相位节省下界。

decision_rows.meaning: `H-2C=(H-2T)+2(T-C)` 逐侧逐 P 精确成立。
若为 true，尾素总包络本身已经闭合；有限审计显示它并非总是 true。
decision_rows.remaining: phase saving is needed where false

decision_rows.meaning: 有限审计中所有尾包络失败点均由二次相位节省补足。
有限扫描未出现精确相位带压力缺陷。
仍需全局证明尾包络正余量或二次相位节省下界。
本步只把相位带 PDEC 拆成两项可攻输入，不关闭全局行/列命题。
